brief_summary: We propose a prospective, randomized, single-blind controlled crossover study to assess the effects of daily egg inclusion versus egg exclusion, on glycemic control, anthropometric measures, and overall diet quality in adults with Type 2 diabetes.
brief_title: Egg Ingestion in Adults With Type 2 Diabetes
official_title: Egg Ingestion in Adults With Type 2 Diabetes: Effects on Glycemic Control, Anthropometry, Diet Quality and Cardiometabolic Status A Randomized, Controlled, Crossover Trial
